category.name: ClickFix / fake verification
category.short: Fake checks that get victims to paste and run a command
category.summary: A fake CAPTCHA, browser update or error message, usually injected into a hacked legitimate website, copies a command to the clipboard and tells the victim to paste it into the Run dialog, a terminal or PowerShell. The command downloads and runs malware, typically an information stealer or a remote-access tool. Some campaigns fetch their next stage from a public blockchain so the hacked site never has to change.
